title: For loops
subStepTitle: Things to Know in C++/Java/Python or any language
intro: For-loops encode counted repetition. Be precise about inclusive/exclusive bounds — off-by-one is the #1 beginner failure mode. Classic framing from the roadmap note “understanding for loop”.
intuition: Index meaning first (0-based vs 1-based), then write the loop header to match.
approach: Keep loop body O(1) work unless nested on purpose.

python.code:
n = int(input())
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    print(i, end=" ")
print()
